name: blueprint/pdf-pipeline
description: PDF operations as receipts: extract text, OCR scans, merge or fill via CLI, publish the result, keep one receipt per step
recipe: extract text (or OCR when the page is a scan) -> extract the structured fields -> merge/fill via CLI -> publish and receipt
pitfalls: scanned PDFs need OCR first - a red receipt marks it
keep tails short - the text is the deliverable, not the log
a failed extraction fails clean - do not half-parse
